regional anesthesia with a neuraxial opioid
non-opioid analgesic at the full daily dose
Women receiving general anesthesia and/or regional anesthesia
At least one non-opioid analgesic at the full daily dose
finding: Administering all three recommended elements of care (regional anesthesia with a neuraxial opioid OR general anesthesia with wound infiltration or a Transversus Abdominis Plane block; at least one non-opioid analgesic at the full daily dose; and pain assessment and recording) was associated with better pain-related outcomes after CS.
